title: epipactis dunensis
intro: Epipactis dunensis, commonly known as Dun Helleborine, is a species of orchid native to the British Isles. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Dun Helleborine are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
